headline: Record bookings, backlog fund raised guide, margins slip
summary_short: Trane Technologies' Q2 2026 revenue rose 10.6% y/y to $6,354M (reported +11%, organic +9%) on record $7,818M bookings (+39% y/y) and a record $12.1B backlog (+70% y/y); GAAP continuing EPS was $4.20 (+9% y/y) as GAAP operating margin fell 100bp to 19.3%.
summary_long: Growth was led by Americas Commercial HVAC, where bookings rose 50% and organic revenue grew low-teens, driving the record $12.1B backlog (+70% y/y) and 123% company-wide book-to-bill. EMEA was the weak segment: organic revenue fell 4% and GAAP operating margin dropped 550bp; the release does not explain the decline. Enterprise GAAP operating margin fell 100bp to 19.3% and adjusted EBITDA margin fell 70bp to 21.1%. Trane raised full-year 2026 guidance to ~11.5% reported / ~9% organic revenue growth, GAAP continuing EPS of $15.00-$15.10, and adjusted continuing EPS of $15.20-$15.30. YTD free cash flow was $1.6B; the company repurchased $756M of shares and paid $463M of dividends, with $1.3B cash and $4.6B debt at quarter-end.
